metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature in New Mexico higher on July 20-27, 2016 than the 2001-2010 average for the same period?

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Define New Mexico geometry (approximate bounding box)
nm_coords = [[-109.05, 31.34], [-103.00, 31.34], [-103.00, 37.00], [-109.05, 37.00], [-109.05, 31.34]]
nm_geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon(nm_coords)

# 2. Helper function to mask clouds in Landsat
def mask_clouds_ls(image):
    qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL')
    # Mask cloud and cloud shadow bits
    cloud_shadow_bit = 3
    cloud_bit = 5
    mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << cloud_shadow_bit).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << cloud_bit).eq(0))
    return image.updateMask(mask)

def mask_clouds_ls5_7(image):
    qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL')
    cloud_shadow_bit = 3
    cloud_bit = 5
    mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << cloud_shadow_bit).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << cloud_bit).eq(0))
    return image.updateMask(mask)

# Helper to compute LST from thermal band (Landsat 8: Band 10)
def compute_lst_ls8(image):
    # Thermal band (Band 10) in DN; convert to radiance then brightness temperature then LST
    # ML (radiance_multiplicative_constant) from metadata ~ 0.0003342
    # AL (radiance_additive_constant) from metadata ~ 0.1
    # ML and AL are generic; using Landsat 8 defaults
    ml = 0.0003342
    al = 0.1
    ml_bt = 0.0003342
    al_bt = 0.1
    
    # Load thermal constant (K1 ~ 774.8853, K2 ~ 480.8883 for Band 10)
    k1 = 774.8853
    k2 = 480.8883
    
    thermal = image.select('B10').multiply(ml).add(al)
    bt = k2.divide(thermal.divide(k1).add(1).log()).subtract(273.15)  # BT in Celsius
    
    # Simplified LST approximation (without NDVI correction for this analysis)
    # Using brightness temperature as proxy for LST
    lst_k = bt.add(273.15)  # Convert back to Kelvin for consistency
    return image.addBands(lst_k.rename('LST'))

def compute_lst_ls5_7(image):
    # Landsat 5/7: Band 6 (thermal)
    ml = 0.055375
    al = 1.18243
    k1 = 607.76
    k2 = 1260.56
    
    thermal = image.select('B6').multiply(ml).add(al)
    bt = k2.divide(thermal.divide(k1).add(1).log()).subtract(273.15)
    lst_k = bt.add(273.15)
    return image.addBands(lst_k.rename('LST'))

# 3. Acquire 2016 data (July 20-27, 2016) - Landsat 8
print("=== 2016 Data (July 20-27, 2016) ===")
col_2016 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') \
    .filterBounds(nm_geom) \
    .filterDate('2016-07-20', '2016-07-28') \
    .map(mask_clouds_ls) \
    .map(compute_lst_ls8)

size_2016 = col_2016.size().getInfo()
print(f"2016 Images found: {size_2016}")

if size_2016 == 0:
    print("No Landsat 8 images for July 20-27, 2016.")
    print("C1")
else:
    # Calculate mean LST for 2016
    img_2016_mosaic = col_2016.select('LST').mean()
    stats_2016 = img_2016_mosaic.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=nm_geom,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    mean_lst_2016 = stats_2016.get('LST_mean')
    count_2016 = stats_2016.get('LST_count')
    print(f"2016 Mean LST: {mean_lst_2016:.2f} K, Valid pixels: {int(count_2016) if count_2016 else 0}")
    
    if count_2016 == 0 or mean_lst_2016 is None:
        print("No valid pixels for 2016 after masking.")
        print("C2")
    else:
        # 4. Acquire baseline data (July 20-27, 2001-2010) - Landsat 5/7
        print("\n=== Baseline Data (July 20-27, 2001-2010) ===")
        col_baseline = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') \
            .filterBounds(nm_geom) \
            .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(7, 7, 'month')) \
            .filter(ee.Filter.dayOfYear(201, 208)) \
            .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2001, 2010, 'year')) \
            .map(mask_clouds_ls5_7) \
            .map(compute_lst_ls5_7)
        
        size_baseline = col_baseline.size().getInfo()
        print(f"Baseline images found (LS5): {size_baseline}")
        
        if size_baseline == 0:
            # Try Landsat 7
            col_baseline = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') \
                .filterBounds(nm_geom) \
                .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(7, 7, 'month')) \
                .filter(ee.Filter.dayOfYear(201, 208)) \
                .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2001, 2010, 'year')) \
                .map(mask_clouds_ls5_7) \
                .map(compute_lst_ls5_7)
            size_baseline = col_baseline.size().getInfo()
            print(f"Baseline images found (LS7): {size_baseline}")
        
        if size_baseline == 0:
            print("No baseline data available.")
            print("C1")
        else:
            # Calculate mean LST for baseline
            img_baseline_mosaic = col_baseline.select('LST').mean()
            stats_baseline = img_baseline_mosaic.reduceRegion(
                reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
                geometry=nm_geom,
                scale=1000,
                maxPixels=1e9
            ).getInfo()
            
            mean_lst_baseline = stats_baseline.get('LST_mean')
            count_baseline = stats_baseline.get('LST_count')
            print(f"Baseline Mean LST: {mean_lst_baseline:.2f} K, Valid pixels: {int(count_baseline) if count_baseline else 0}")
            
            if count_baseline == 0 or mean_lst_baseline is None:
                print("No valid pixels for baseline after masking.")
                print("C2")
            else:
                # 5. Comparison
                print(f"\n=== Comparison ===")
                print(f"2016 Mean LST: {mean_lst_2016:.2f} K")
                print(f"Baseline Mean LST: {mean_lst_baseline:.2f} K")
                print(f"Difference: {mean_lst_2016 - mean_lst_baseline:.2f} K")
                
                # Validate LST is in reasonable range (280-320 K ~ 7-47 C)
                if mean_lst_2016 < 250 or mean_lst_2016 > 350 or mean_lst_baseline < 250 or mean_lst_baseline > 350:
                    print("LST values out of reasonable range.")
                    print("C3")
                elif mean_lst_2016 > mean_lst_baseline:
                    print("A")
                else:
                    print("B")
